# SPECIFICATION TECHNIQUE - AeroValve AV-3000

Revision Rev F

## 1 — Objet et Domaine d'Application

La presente specification definit les exigences techniques pour le produit AeroValve AV-3000, revision Rev F.

## 2 — Documents de Reference

Normes applicables : EN 9100, EASA Part 21.

## 3 — Exigences Techniques

Voir sections détailles ci-apres.

## 4 — Essais et Controles

Essais d'acceptation selon la procedure PR-QA-042.

## 5 — Conditionnement et Marquage

Les produits seront conditionnés selon la norme MIL-STD-2073.

Insurance coverage under the Group's professional indemnity policy has been verified. The applicable deductible is EUR 500,000 per claim, with an aggregate annual limit of EUR 50,000,000.

This Agreement may not be assigned, in whole or in part, by either Party without the prior written consent of the other Party. Any unauthorized assignment shall be void and of no effect.

The Supplier shall maintain ISO 9001 certification (and AS9100 or NADCAP where applicable) throughout the Term. Loss of certification shall constitute a material breach entitling the Customer to suspend Purchase Orders.

The solution heat treatment and ageing cycle was carried out as prescribed: solution at 940 degrees C for 2 hours, water quench, followed by ageing at 540 degrees C for 8 hours, air cool.

A review of cross-indemnity provisions among Group entities has been initiated to determine which entity bears the ultimate financial burden of the litigation.

Statistical process control (SPC) monitoring is in place for critical dimensions identified in control plan CP-AV3000-Rev.F. Process capability indices Cpk exceed 1.67 for all key characteristics.

Dimensional inspections were performed on a Metrologix M-G2 coordinate measuring machine (CMM), calibrated and certified in accordance with ISO 10360-2. The expanded measurement uncertainty (k=2) is  $ \pm 0.003 $ mm.

A conflict-of-interest check has been performed to ensure that the appointed external counsel does not represent any adverse party or have any relationship that could compromise the objectivity of their advice.

The Legal Department recommends appointment of a mediator accredited by the Centre for Effective Dispute Resolution (CEDR) to attempt settlement before the commencement of substantive proceedings.

--- Page 2 ---

An examination of notification obligations to insurers has been completed. The claim notification was submitted within the contractual timeframe.

The applicable reference documentation for this lot is specification SP-AV3000-Rev.D dated 01/11/2019, together with control plan CP-AV3000-Rev.D and manufacturing routing MR-AV3000-Rev.D.

The 3.1 material certificate per EN 10204 has been verified and the mechanical properties (UTS, YS, EI%, hardness) conform to the requirements of AMS 4928 for Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy.

It is recommended that no public statement be made regarding this matter, given the confidentiality obligations under the mediation clause and the potential for reputational harm.

Effectiveness verification of the corrective actions will be performed over the next three production lots. The CAPA will be closed after confirming no recurrence over a minimum of 150 parts.

In the event of late delivery, the Customer shall be entitled to liquidated damages of 0.5% of the relevant Purchase Order value per week of delay, capped at 10% of the total Purchase Order value.

The Group's litigation history in comparable matters shows an amicable resolution rate of approximately 65%, with settlement amounts averaging 45% of the initial claim.

All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by registered mail, internationally recognized courier service, or email with read receipt confirmation, to the addresses set forth in the preamble.

Calibration of the hydraulic test bench TB-042 was verified prior to testing. Calibration certificate No. CC-2024-042-012, issued by a UKAS-accredited laboratory, is included in the batch record.

The Legal Department has identified a contagion risk, as the facts underlying the claim may be replicated at other production sites within the Group.

The batch record review was completed by the Head of Quality and Airworthiness prior to lot release. All identified non-conformities have been dispositioned and closed.

generation_archetype.label: Quality, batch record, audit, and certification
generation_archetype.focus: lot IDs, certificates, checklist status, test results, specifications, non-conformities, and missing artifacts
perfect_guidance: Use exact lot, certificate, checklist, conformance, or missing-artifact facts.
A missing or incomplete status is valid only when the evidence explicitly says ABSENT, INCOMPLET, missing, or equivalent.
ambiguous_guidance: Use one supported artifact, test, checklist, or lot fact.
Pair it with one unresolved limitation about audit completeness, missing attachments, traceability, or certification coverage.
wrong_guidance: Mutate lot number, conformance status, missing artifact, test result, supplier, or certificate.
Do not leave any unsupported quality claim partially grounded.
